notes: release_date: blog publishedTime 2026-05-31T17:31:18Z = 2026-06-01 Beijing; MiniMax release-notes index lists Jun. 1, 2026. Scores verified from DOM prose: SWE-Bench Pro 59.0, Terminal-Bench 2.1 66.0, SWE-fficiency 34.8, KernelBench Hard 28.8, MCP Atlas 74.2, PostTrainBench 0.37 (with Opus 4.7 0.42 / GPT-5.5 0.39 as comparison_cited), OSWorld-Verified 68.70->70.06 (100->200 steps), Video-MME 84.6 at 512 frames. All remaining values live in the results table image (no DOM table) and hero chart image; rows are pending with vision-read values in notes only. Open conflicts: (1) hero chart vision read gave 75.2 for OSWorld-Verified vs 70.06 confirmed by prose+table; (2) VideoMME has two conditions (85.4 w/ subtitles in table, 84.6 at 512 frames in prose) kept as separate rows; (3) IMO/USAMO competitor cells mix points and percent. Blog states technical report and open weights were promised 'over the next 10 days' after release.

locator.quote_snippet: Increasing Max Steps from 100 to 200 improved task completion rate from 68.70% to 70.06%

protocol.harness: official OSWorld-Verified codebase (testing script announced open-source)

benchmark_evidence.notes: Methodology prose states both 68.70% (100 steps) and 70.06% (200 steps); the results table image prints 70.06 for the final configuration. Hero chart image vision-read suggested 75.2 for this row, which conflicts with both text sources; treat 70.06 as the cross-confirmed value and flag the chart read for human review. Protocol: 361 samples from nogdrive collection, relative coordinates 0-1000, resolution 1920x1080, Max Steps 200.

locator.heading: Evaluation Methodology

protocol.token_budget: M3: max output 16K; external: max output 64K

benchmark_evidence.notes: new-benchmark: video-mme not yet in data/benchmarks.json. Methodology note: official protocol allows 1024 frames but external API limited to 640; M3 scored 84.6 at 512 frames. Separate from the table-image 'VideoMME (w/ sub)' row (85.4, vision-read) - different frame budget and subtitle condition; do not merge. Protocol: 1 FPS, single-frame long edge 336-672px, subtitles interleaved every 30s, official prompt, LLM-as-a-Judge, M3 max output 16K, temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95.
